name: Trade Query Execution Frequency 3
definition: Specifies the frequency of the trade query execution.

FrequencyType.name: Frequency Type
FrequencyType.definition: Specifies the frequency type of the trade query execution.

DeliveryDay.name: Delivery Day
DeliveryDay.definition: Specifies the day of the expected delivery of the query response.

DayOfMonth.name: Day Of Month
DayOfMonth.definition: Day of the month of the monthly query execution.

Frequency1Rule.definition: If FrequencyType is Adhoc (ADHO), then DeliveryDay must be present.

Frequency2Rule.definition: If FrequencyType is Weekly (WEEK), then DeliveryDay must be present and may occur only once.

Frequency3Rule.definition: If FrequencyType is Monthly (MNTH), then DayOfMonth must be present and may occur only once.
